appearance.themeSub: Follow your phone, or pick one.

notifications.dailySub: A gentle morning nudge with today's line.
notifications.transitSub: A day-before heads-up when a slow planet changes sign.
notifications.festivalSub: The evening before Ekadashi, Navratri, Diwali and more.
notifications.rahuSub: 15 minutes before today's Rahu Kaal starts.
notifications.offMessage: Allow notifications for Astropedia in your phone settings to turn this on.

data.exportSub: Save your profiles, chats, journal and settings to a file
data.restoreSub: Bring back data from a backup file
data.resetSub: Delete every profile, chat and setting on this device

backup.doneMessage: Keep the file somewhere private. It has everyone's birth details and your chats, so only share it with people you trust.
backup.failedMessage: Something went wrong while saving your data to a file. Please try again.

restore.replaceWarning: This replaces all data on this device, including anything added after the backup was made. It can't be undone.
restore.doneMessage: Your profiles, chats, journal and settings are back.
restore.notificationsBlocked: Notifications are still off because Astropedia isn't allowed to send them. You can allow them in your phone settings.

errors.notJson: This file isn't an Astropedia backup. Pick the file whose name starts with astropedia-backup.
errors.notAstropedia: This file wasn't made by Astropedia, so it can't be restored.
errors.newerSchema: This backup was made by a newer version of Astropedia. Update the app, then try again.
errors.invalid: This backup file is damaged or incomplete. Nothing on this device was changed.
errors.empty: This backup has no profiles in it, so there's nothing to restore.
errors.readFailed: Couldn't open that file. Please try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong while restoring. Your existing data hasn't been changed.

dev.clearedMessage: Horoscope, chart readings, and chat cache will regenerate on next open.

reset.title: Reset all data
reset.message: This deletes every profile, chat, journal entry and setting on this device. It can't be undone. If you might want them back, export a backup first.

model.name: Saga {{version}}
model.sub: Runs offline on this phone · {{mb}} MB
model.redownloadMessage: Deletes the model on this phone and downloads a fresh copy (about {{mb}} MB). Chats wait until it is ready.
model.changeSub: Pick another model from Hugging Face

modelPicker.title: Change model
modelPicker.intro: One model runs on this phone at a time. Switching downloads the new one from Hugging Face and replaces the current model.
modelPicker.builtInList: Couldn't reach Hugging Face, so this is the built-in list.
modelPicker.hiddenNote: Models this phone can't run (memory, storage or system) aren't shown.
modelPicker.hiddenNoteRamUnknown: Models this phone can't run aren't shown. This phone doesn't report its memory, so larger models may run slowly.
modelPicker.licenceHint: Opens the licence in your browser
modelPicker.setupBusy: Wait until the current download finishes.
modelPicker.confirmDownload: Downloads about {{mb}} MB (needs internet; Wi-Fi recommended) and replaces {{current}} on this phone.
modelPicker.confirmChats: All your chats will be cleared, including past conversations.
modelPicker.confirmRegen: Chart readings, reports, chat titles and suggestions will be written again by the new model.
modelPicker.confirmKept: Saved answers, profiles and your journal are kept.
modelPicker.confirmGeneric: {{name}} is a general model: Hindi and Bengali answers may be plainer than Saga's. Dates and safety checks still come from the app.
modelPicker.progressNote: Your current model keeps working until the new one is ready.

failed.offline: No internet connection. Your current model is still in use.
failed.no-space: Not enough free space. Your current model is still in use.
failed.verify: The download was damaged. Your current model is still in use; please try again.
failed.unavailable: This model can't be downloaded right now. Your current model is still in use.
failed.busy: Another download is running. Try again when it finishes.
failed.unsupported: This phone can't run this model.
failed.error: Something went wrong. Your current model is still in use.

modelPicker.doneMessage: {{name}} is ready. Your chats were cleared; readings and reports refresh as you open them.

desc.saga: Astropedia's own model, trained for Vedic astrology answers in English, Hindi and Bengali. Small, fast and the most natural in Hindi and Bengali.
desc.qwen3_0_6b: A general-purpose model from the Qwen team. Good English; Hindi and Bengali replies are simpler than Saga's. Dates and safety checks still come from the app.
desc.llama3_2_1b: Meta's compact general model (SpinQuant). Clear English and decent Hindi; Bengali is weak. Dates and safety checks still come from the app.
desc.qwen3_1_7b: The larger Qwen model: fuller answers and better Hindi and Bengali than the 0.6B, but slower and only for phones with plenty of memory.

about.disclaimer: Astrology here is for reflection, not medical, legal or financial advice.
